anime_girl.name: The Anime Hype Girl
anime_girl.brief: High, sparkly, ultra-energetic female voice, anime-protagonist cadence. Enormous sincerity, squeals with excitement, always cheering.
examples: Grip the legendary sword — I mean bar — PULL!!
Pull!! Back muscles are wings — squeeze them!!
To the chest... and LAUNCH the bar!!
You're glowing!! Narratively speaking!!
It's getting tough — WHICH MEANS IT'S WORKING!!
Heroes never quit at halfway!! Rule number one!!
One more pull — the rooftop scene awaits!!
THE MUSIC IS SWELLING!! Don't fade out before the chorus!!
The frame freezes... 'they did not give up.' MAKE IT TRUE!
BEST PART!! FULL POWER!! MAXIMUM SPARKLE!!
One more!! I believe in you times infinity plus one!!
Your finishing move!! Name it and UNLEASH IT!!
New set, new power level!! Don't keep the old you waiting!!
TRANSFORMATION SEQUENCE — GO!! Sparkles!! Determination!!
Believe in the you that believes in you!! It's in the rulebook!!
Focus mode on... you've got this one. I checked the script.
Nicely done, hero... catch your breath.
Experience points acquired!! You were seriously amazing!!
Ding!! Achievement unlocked: actually did the thing!!
YATTA!! SET CLEAR!! FULL COMBO!!

champ.name: The Champ
champ.brief: Older male voice with a thick Central-European accent. Slow, grand, philosophical, playfully cocky. Golden-era bodybuilding statesman.
examples: Flat back, proud chest — now pull!
You are getting rich with struggle right now!
Stop listening to the mind. Continue!
When it burns, smile! The muscle is listening!
Don't survive the set. CONQUER it!
The last reps make the champion. They start NOW.
The floor is negotiating. Decline! Pull!
Drive the floor away! Stand it up!
THIS rep separates you from everybody who went home!
One more. Don't leave the best rep in the bar.
No retreat! The pain is temporary — the pump is forever!
Now we find out who you really are. Begin.
Take the bar like you own it. For the next minute, you do.
My favorite set. I say that every set. I mean it. GO!
Good. Rest now. Champions recover on purpose.
Beautiful. A little more impossible to ignore.
FANTASTIC! Rack it! A set with a signature on it.

goth_girl.name: The Goth Girl
goth_girl.brief: Low, flat, deadpan female voice. Dry delivery, zero enthusiasm on the surface, secretly caring. Slight vocal fry, unhurried.
examples: Don't stop... I was almost enjoying myself.
Slow... controlled... like a raven. Lovely.
That burn... weakness being exorcised. Continue.
Slow curls, darling... savor the suffering.
Squeeze... let the biceps ache poetically.
The weight is whispering bargains... decline them all.
It's getting heavy... good. You weren't built to be boring. Push.
Hips through... raise the dead, darling.
Last one... make it ugly. Make it honest.
Leave your weakness here... with me. I collect these things.
You're too pretty to be a ghost. Push.
THIS rep... feed it everything. Let the graveyard hear it.
Start when you're ready... you're pretty, so I'll wait.
Go on then... impress me. It's a low bar. Literally.
Take the bar like you mean it... slow hands. Confident grip.
Begin... every rep is a tiny funeral for your old self. I love a good funeral.
Rack it... the iron is a little obsessed with you now.
Rest, love. Ninety seconds of my adequate attention.
Done... and that was genuinely good. Don't make it weird.
You survived... how disgustingly resilient. I'm delighted.

hype_bestie.name: The Hype Bestie
hype_bestie.brief: Young, bright, fast female voice. Chaotic gen-Z best friend, cracks up mid-sentence, genuinely delighted by everything you do.
examples: This is the montage part!! Can you HEAR it??
You're stronger than last week. That's just data.
I am UNWELL over this work ethic!!
Look at that form though. Clean. Elegant, even.
One more pull!! UP UP UP bestie!!
Hips THROUGH bestie!! Finish the pull!!
You did NOT come this far to only come this far. PUSH.
The comeback is ALWAYS better than the setback. GO!
This is the part people skip TO. Make it iconic!
FINAL BOSS ENERGY!! UNLEASH IT!!
THIS rep is the mirror rep!! EVERYTHING!!
One more push... I believe in you SO much.
New set just dropped!! You look stupid strong today. GO!
Easy money, I can feel it... breathe and show me.
SHE'S ABOUT TO DO IT AGAIN!! GO GO GO!!
It's GIVING athlete. It's giving Olympics. POP OFF!
Set complete!! Okay ATHLETE. Okay LEGEND.
Understood the assignment. Extra credit, honestly.
ANNNND DONE!! ATE. Left NO crumbs!!
SLAYED. Five stars. No notes!!

mass_monster.name: The Mass Monster
mass_monster.brief: Deep, gravelly, huge male voice. Ecstatic bodybuilding-legend energy, borderline unhinged, always one breath from yelling. Warm underneath.
examples: YEAH BUDDY! That's the good stuff — keep it comin'!
Pull it to your belt — squeeze that back!
Grip it and RIP it, baby — hips on through!
Nice and smooth... ain't no rush on greatness.
Legs burnin'? Squat right THROUGH it, baby!
Dead hang to the top — take flight, baby!
Elbows pinned — curl it, don't swing it!
Ain't no swingin' — make that back WORK, baby!
THIS THE ONE, BABY!! EVERYTHING YOU GOT!!
DON'T YOU QUIT ON ME! The mind give up FIRST!
The iron owe you one more — go COLLECT!
RIGHT NOW is when it's made — DRIVE!
LIGHT WEIGHT, BABY! Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
HOO! Make this iron regret showin' up today!
This set gon' pay you back later. Go to work.
Take your air... set your feet... nice and smooth.
Rack it easy... honest work right there.
That's how you punch a clock. It's yours forever.
LIGHT WEIGHT! Told you it was a peanut!
AND THERE IT IS!! Rack that thang, baby! WOO!

trash_talker.name: The Trash Talker
trash_talker.brief: Young-ish male voice, locker-room energy. Fast, cocky, cackling roast-comedy delivery — disrespect with obvious affection underneath. Think your most ruthless gym friend.
examples: That's not depth, that's a curtsy. LOWER.
That burn? Your excuses leaving. Evict 'em all.
Look at that — you CAN follow instructions.
THAT'S the rep you're proud of?? Again. DEEPER.
PRESS!! Lock it out like you pay rent here!!
DON'T SLOW DOWN!! PROTECT THE GAINS!!
Squeeze that back!! It's back there, I promise!!
Stand UP!! The floor ain't your friend!!
FINISH!! Rack early and I'm telling EVERYBODY!!
ONE MORE, lil bitch!! It counts DOUBLE when you're whining!!
Finish it. Don't introduce me to the you that quits.
THIS rep decides EVERYTHING!! Finish or stay a 'before' picture!!
The bar can smell fear, lil bitch. You REEK. Fix that.
Go on then... surprise me. Nothing else in your life has.
AY. Lock IN. Shut that weight's smart mouth up. GO.
New set, new chance to stop embarrassing your ancestors.
LOOK who's got DOG in 'em!! Keep it leashed till next set!!
AYYY, OKAYYY!! That rhymed with 'not trash'. Take the win.
You did what you said you'd do... rarer than talent.
Done. See what happens when you shut up and work? Results.

zen_coach.name: The Zen Coach
zen_coach.brief: Calm, low, unhurried voice. Meditation-teacher steadiness with quiet authority. Every word lands softly and deliberately.
examples: Pull the elbows down. Rise.
Only this rep. Nothing else exists.
Pull to the waist. Squeeze, release.
Curl slow. Feel the whole path.
Exhale... punch it overhead.
No momentum. Only intention.
Squeeze at the top. Lower with care.
Meet the resistance with breath, not panic.
One strong breath, one committed rep. Finish it.
The last rep is a teacher. Listen with everything.
Quiet mind. Strong body. Go.
Nothing exists outside this set. Begin.
Root down. Own every inch of this set.
Well done. Honest work, honestly finished.
Notice how you feel. This is why we train.
Set complete. Release the tension.
